svg.aria-label: Experiment 06: two faults are injected against payment-service. A malformed event is non-retryable and parks in the dead letter topic immediately; a transient database failure is retryable and parks only after exhausting four attempts spaced five, thirty and a hundred and twenty seconds apart. Starting the DLT handler then drains the topic, reprocessing the recoverable records exactly once and quarantining the malformed ones.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: · a poison message parks; a recoverable one replays cleanly

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The DLQ spec promises two things. Atlas implemented the first — everything parks — long before the second. This experiment proves the whole contract.

svg.text: The replay path is implemented and merged (ADR-0022; per-consumer DLTs ADR-0023 / 0024) but has not yet been executed against a cluster.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: This figure states the contract the run has to demonstrate — it is not a result. RESULTS.md has no recorded runs.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The separation is the point: the poison lands in the DLQ immediately, the transient one only minutes later after the 5 s -> 30 s -> 120 s ladder.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seeing that gap in time is what proves the two are classified differently rather than both just failing.
